Class Image

java.lang.Object
bg.tu_varna.sit.cs.f24621858.image.format.Image
Direct Known Subclasses:
NetpbmFormatImage
public abstract class Image extends Object
Abstract base class representing a raster image.

An image has a name (typically its file path), dimensions (width and height in pixels), and a three-dimensional pixel array.

Pixel layout

Pixels are stored as int[height][width][channels], where channels depends on the colour model:
  • grayscale – 1 channel; values are in the range [0, maxPixelValue].
  • RGB – 3 channels ordered R, G, B; each in [0, maxPixelValue].
Author:
Dmitro Dashchenko

  • Constructor Details

    • Image

      public Image(String name, int width, int height, int channels) throws InvalidImageDataException
      Constructs a new Image with the given name and dimensions.
      Parameters:
      name - the file path or logical name; must not be null
      width - image width in pixels; must be ≥ 0
      height - image height in pixels; must be ≥ 0
      channels - bytes in one pixel; must be equal 1 or 3
      Throws:
      InvalidImageDataException - if name is null or either dimension is negative
